items.name: @q253595422/dsh-imagegen-video
items.description: AI image AND video generation plugin for the dsh web GUI, with a complete video pipeline alongside the image pipeline. Images: text-to-image and image-to-image through configurable provider channels (gpt-image-2 / grok-imagine-image / nanobanana series / seedream-5.0-pro / dall-e-3, with native xAI Grok Imagine, Google Nano Banana and ByteDance Seedream request shaping), per-channel model catalogs, a three-column studio beside the native conversation, an infinite canvas with node-graph workflows (annotation boxes with attached prompt cards, local background removal, AI layer split, per-node model choice, file nodes with any-file upload, and a canvas skill system covering skill-driven next steps on every node: text polish, image description, content extraction, and long-running headless-agent pipelines such as image-to-editable-ppt, with a local skill library that installs and removes skills from URLs or uploaded archives), an ecommerce product-set mode and a prompt template library. Video: text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes with per-channel video model catalogs, an async submit/poll/download pipeline, a clip history merged into the sidebar, favorited clips in the asset library, host-side Agent video tools, video nodes on the infinite canvas with the same controls as image nodes, a storyboard node whose shot list runs one clip per shot into ordinary video nodes (independent shots or each shot starting from the previous shot's last frame; any finished clip can also turn its tail frame into a ready-to-run frame node), clip stitching of two or more canvas video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg in canvas reading order, and a graph-level workflow runner that walks a whole connected chain in dependency order. A director step runs before every render, decomposing a one-line request into shots, motion, camera work, duration and style, and the plan it produces is what the provider is sent (duration and frame may only narrow, never widen); the plan is previewable without rendering, echoed on the task and stored in the clip history.

Installing this bundle auto-installs all four presets (v1 was removed at v2.0.0). Each preset also writes a FINAL PAPER by default when its run concludes — and does so BEFORE the run is marked complete: on v4/v5 the team co-authors its parts, merges them, cross-reviews, and the editor named by paperEditor finalises; the output is Paper/<run or institute id>/{paper.md,paper.tex,paper.pdf when a LaTeX engine is detected,paper.meta.json,paper.log.md} (params finalPaper/paperFormat/paperLanguage/paperCompilePdf/paperLatexCommand, plus paperEditor on v4/v5; see docs/final-paper.md).

items.name: @falling-ts/dsh-force-compact
items.description: DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step + agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the "强制压缩配置" settings namespace (disableThinking, autoThresholdTokens, retainLatestTokens, turnEndForceCompactionEnabled). When the threshold fires (or /force-compact queues while busy), the latest `retainLatestTokens` of the conversation's surface tokens are KEPT VERBATIM and everything before that cutoff is COMPACTED INTO A SINGLE SUMMARY NODE in one LLM call (original span entries become shadowed/skipped). Also compacts at each turn/end and at each session/flush durability checkpoint. Host half is a pure listener; a web client half registers a settings.section (强制压缩 / Force Compact) that reads and writes the same settings namespace.

items.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
items.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). items.name: dsh-code-server-app
items.description: VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.

items.description: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的桌宠，八种配色皮肤随时切换，并且有性格：只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；被连点几次会躺平，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴；她记仇也记好——今天被叫胖三次就冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近；离开半小时再回来她会嘴硬地说「才不是等你」；头几次见面她怕生；十分钟没人理就游去角落（只改视觉，不改你放她的位置）。A desktop pet called "Big Fat Fish" (nickname Jingjing) for the DSH web GUI, with eight switchable colour skins and a personality: she eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere. Rapid clicks make her lie down and refuse to react; calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not; the nickname 鲸鲸 pleases her. She keeps count both ways - three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm; come back after half an hour and she greets you with "I was not waiting for you"; the first few meetings she is shy; ten quiet minutes and she drifts to a corner, visually only, never moving the position you chose. The eight images are PNGs bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself.

items.name: @jipika/dsh-memory
items.description: Progressive long-term memory for DSH: sharded markdown bodies under ~/.dsh/memory/topics/, with only a live-generated map (shard · keywords · count · latest date) injected into the system prompt, entries pulled on demand via grep + read — so the prompt cost stays flat however large the memory grows. Two layers (global + per-project) plus the global rule files, viewable AND editable in DSH Settings, with per-layer switches and an index/full injection toggle. v0.5.0 adds enforcement hooks: a write guard on the native tool pipeline (format/secrets/history rules, optional external command judge, deny/ask with reasons fed back to the model), post-write audit log, a read reminder when memory files are read, a mandatory discipline block, and an optional injection filter command. Zero extra LLM cost, live re-read. v0.5.1 keeps the switches in ~/.dsh/memory/settings.json — read live by the plugin and edited from the settings pane over the plugin's own route, independent of the host settings API. v0.6.0 fixes the index silently degrading to a title-less directory once memory outgrew the hardcoded 9k budget (which is why an agent could see memory injected and still never read it): the index now shrinks per-shard along a newest-N-per-shard ladder under a configurable indexBudget, adds per-shard keywords (routing hint) and latest-entry dates, ships a 'check memory before starting a task' discipline, and makes full mode read the shard bodies (auto-falling back to index when over budget) instead of the retired memory.md navigation file. v0.7.0 makes 'map' the default injection mode (shard-level map only, no entry titles): retrieval = grep the memory dir with task keywords, then read the matched line; layers with <=12 entries stay inlined; the discipline block teaches that two-step path and routes cross-shard lookups (>=3 entries / >=2 shards / >=3k body) to a subagent that returns facts + line numbers instead of raw bodies. v0.9.0 adds the card-memory layer for roleplay sessions and makes every path Windows-safe: home resolution follows os.homedir() (so an undefined or empty HOME no longer roots paths at the drive root), tool and bash paths are normalized before guard matching, and drive-letter cwds produce valid project slugs. v0.9.2 fixes retrieval ranking at scale (IDF-weighted entry scores, df=0 CJK bigram fragments excluded from the coverage gate, BM25-style length normalization, preview windows anchored on the rarest matched token instead of a fixed 240-char head cut; measured locally: shards covered per top-8 2.88->5.75, largest tie block 4.38->1.13, previews containing a matched token 67%->100%): shard-level bonuses no longer inflate every entry in that shard (they were added inside the entry loop, so all hits from one shard shared an identical score and ordering collapsed to date-then-line), a per-shard quota stops one shard from filling the whole result page, and the default scope is the current project layer (other projects' shards — 60% of the pool locally — are skipped but reported in dropped.offScopeLayers/offScopeFiles, with scope:'all' to opt back in). v0.9.3 stops query function words from being searched at all (a CJK stopword set plus Latin stopwords, judged per-token so a real word that merely contains a stopword character stays searchable) and rejects sub-2-character queries, which previously collapsed into an unfiltered whole-library substring match: on the local corpus 'the/of/...'-style Chinese stopword-only queries went from 1270 hits to 0, and a single-character query from 1459 hits to a clean rejection, while the 15-query positive suite kept 14/15 recall with per-query hit counts unchanged (ranking, IDF, length normalization, per-shard quota and preview anchoring are untouched). v0.9.4 adds the mapless injection mode: the global shard map stops living in the system prompt entirely (locally measured: 188 shards = 40364 chars injected every turn) and is replaced by a fixed 370-char pointer, while shard-level routing moves into the memory_search reply as a query-scored top-8 bridge. Measured on 10 real tasks from this machine: entry-level retrieval alone finds the right shard in 6/10, the bridge in 10/10 (the 4 tasks entries miss, the bridge returns at rank #1) because a task phrased in Chinese colloquial prose cannot literally match an English shard name, and bridge scoring only needs topic-level overlap. Injection size becomes independent of memory growth and no longer invalidates the KV prefix when a memory is written. Bridge cost averages 1378 chars and only pays on turns that actually search. Also consolidates the inject-mode whitelist, which was the same ternary chain copy-pasted in three places (host 1 + client 2), into normalizeInjectMode()/INJECT_MODES plus a probe assertion that both tables agree, and keeps the per-shard over-limit warning in the bridge because the map that used to carry it is gone.

items.name: dsh-dock
items.description: One-click desktop launcher for DSH Harness: automatically installs a prebuilt native app (DSH Harness.exe, whale icon) on the desktop when the plugin activates (parameters auto-detected from the environment); the app starts DSH hidden and opens the GUI as a fullscreen Edge app window, and leaves a tray-resident whale with live server status, one-click server restart and optional boot autostart. The sidebar 鲸湾 (Whale Bay) menu (Reload / Restart server / Full exit) renders as a plain sidebar.footer.action neighbor via React portals — no DOM relocation, no hidden native triggers — so it coexists with every other footer-action plugin (including dynamic Cordis plugins) and follows the harness display language; a dsh-dock settings page (tray residency / autostart / extra DSH install paths) lives in the Settings dialog. Candidate discovery is adaptive: it auto-scans every global install the machine exposes — the running Node, roaming npm, WinGet Node versions and nvm-windows version dirs — by probing each unique node's `npm root -g` (v0.6), and lets the user add any custom install path from the settings page (v0.7), so no one ever has to relocate a differently-installed dsh. v0.8: the tray poll cadence adapts to state (1.5s while booting/restarting, 15s steady) and a file watcher delivers the sidebar restart request, Full exit finishes as soon as the host signals disposal instead of waiting out a fixed watchdog, and a restart request is consumed exactly once.

Includes set_model / list_models agent tools, preset mode with switch_preset / list_presets, presets that declare reasoning effort only so one model can retune its own thinking depth, a configurable stage-to-preset prompt, plan-mode auto-transition, provider whitelist and context-window guards, active-model runtime context injection, and a bundled Web settings page. 为 DSH 提供的插件：通过 TypeSafe Jev 决策模型（每轮读取指令、判断任务类型并选出档位）或调模工具调用，让 Agent 根据任务场景自主切换模型预设和思考深度。含 set_model / list_models 自主调模工具、switch_preset / list_presets 档位切换、只声明思考强度即可在同一模型上调节思考深度的档位、可配置的「阶段→档位」提示词、Plan 模式自动升降级、Provider 白名单与上下文窗口护栏、活跃模型运行时上下文注入，以及插件自带设置页。

items.name: @restregular/dsh-visual-browser
items.description: Visual browser for DeepSeek Harness: a right-sidebar tab under the built-in Browser that keeps one tab strip per workspace (sessions in the same workspace share it; other workspaces never see those pages) with a follow/takeover flag remembered per workspace, and opens each Agent URL in a new tab of that workspace, streaming Chrome live as a binary JPEG frame stream (no screenshot polling) while the Agent drives it through a token-light numbered view of interactive elements, never the raw DOM, and hands each acting tool back the picture itself so click → screenshot → read is one call. The panel keeps real pages as Chrome-style tabs that always show, adopts tabs the page opens itself, reorders by drag with a frosted-glass lift, carries a right-click menu (refresh, copy the link, open it in your own default browser, reference the page in the chat, close, close all), suggests the browsing history under the address box in every tab (title - domain rows, prefix filtering, arrow-key picking, per-entry delete), can be handed over to the Agent with a Follow switch that locks it behind an orange-edged mask while the live picture jumps to whichever tab the Agent touches, forwards clicks, drags, wheel and typing straight to the DevTools input domain, fills native file choosers with real paths and writes the values of native date / time / colour pickers that no picture can show, draws its own cursor scaled to the picture, locks the view with a tinted veil while the Agent acts, draws its clicks, scrolls and drags, and shows the active page's own console where scripts can be run. Starts Chrome as an ordinary browser — no webdriver flag, no HeadlessChrome User-Agent, a desktop-sized screen — so sites that bind a login to the browser they hand it to (doubao.com and other ByteDance properties) keep the session instead of signing it out.

items.name: dsh-codex-ui-classic

The Host delete engine is derived from better-dsh-session-deletetool (MIT). No dependency on the @michengai/dsh-codex-ui package at install time. / 把 Codex UI 1.1.49 的界面冻结进插件：侧栏代码内置、用不到的导航裁掉，上游更新不会再把界面换掉；同时补上真正的删除对话——提供 remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession 让会话菜单出现「删除会话」，修好被隐藏的「⋯」按钮，会话带着子智能体或派生对话时先弹家族树勾选。Host 删除引擎改编自 better-dsh-session-deletetool，安装时不再依赖 codex-ui 包。

items.name: dsh-jev-verify
items.description: Jev (TypeSafe System One decision model) for DeepSeek Harness — seven tools: jev_decision (up to 25 typed questions in one parallel call, measured median 266-484 ms), jev_choose (rank 2-10 approaches), jev_batch (one set of up to 5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text, paste-ready sortable table, built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets), jev_usage (local usage panel: measured calls, tokens, cost, rolling windows and an optional hard budget stop), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (auto-guard audit), jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark run 6-way parallel, 4.96 s wall, 96.3% measured). Plus an automatic tool-call guard (10 deterministic rules in two tiers - 7 hard-block, 3 Jev-judged - plus a Jev risk/loop backstop) whose own Jev verdicts are now metered into the usage ledger, an agent/pre-step auto-triage router (0.8.4) that judges each turn's first step and injects plugin-sourced advice so the harness actually calls Jev, system-prompt guidance with mandatory-trigger rules, a GUI settings card, and a money-first composer usage pill that stays silent about quota status and reset countdowns unless a local budget really exists. The /jev mount always answers - a live status page while dashboard.enabled is off. TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint, so the panel reports only locally measured usage against locally configured budgets - never a fabricated provider balance. 0.8.6: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools is an optional peer and never an installed dependency, so a hoisted copy can no longer shadow the host runtime and stall startup. 0.8.5: the local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json by default so the cumulative total survives a restart, the popover derives remaining as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend for that period, the pill asks for that declaration instead of inventing one, and it re-reads the route every 20 s instead of every 60 s. 0.8.5 also adds jev_batch, the batch judge-and-organize tool: 1-20 texts get the same 1-5 judgments in one call, one real API call per text with bounded concurrency, and the result is a paste-ready sortable table where a failed row is reported as failed. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one feature, never the profile.

manual archives and notepad sends start expanded), a right-aligned non-wrapping action bar whose overflow slides under the left selection label, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with an unarchived non-empty segment, oldest-first segment cards with click-to-edit titles, Enter split, Backspace merge (including the same exit animation for empty-card deletion), drag reorder, arrow-key navigation that leaves a card only from the very start / end of its text, delayed hover action groups that collapse after mouse activation and use distinct new-session insert / send icons, in-panel image previews, rotating shortcut tips, busy-send policy, image cleanup, pending badges that follow the live note and refresh the other sessions right after a save, scroll-safe auto refresh and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗，并新增「记事本」设置页：配色主题（同步作用于设置页）、纯色扁平 / 可调模糊的毛玻璃、字体字号、自动 / 手动保存、撤销步数、按钮组与 hover 阈值、AI 提示词预设（只读展示预设内容）、分段最大高度、可把当前面板位置尺寸存为默认。插件提供撤销 / 重做（按钮位于标题栏「复制全部」左侧，输入框仍用原生撤销，输入文字与插入 / 替换输入框也会进入插件历史而不会丢失；发送不进入撤销 / 重做，已发送分段不会被撤回或重发），分段可折叠，支持批量选择、归档、删除与复制；选中文字时 AI 只优化选中部分并在完成后重新选中，程序化改写后会重新测量文本区高度；归档按最新在上并自动滚动，Backspace 删除最后一条活动分段也不会清空归档；顶部工作区下拉只列出存在未归档且非空分段的工作区，点击切换到该工作区的新会话；工具栏为右对齐、不换行的单行按钮区，溢出时隐藏到左侧文本下方，批量操作时「取消选择」位于最左侧；Backspace 删除空分段也有退出动画；批量删除悬停变红；插入 / 发送的新会话图标相互区分；图片不显示名称，删除按钮位于缩略图右上角；分段进出都有过渡动画，自动保存不再把列表滚回顶部；AI 优化提高短内容输出预算并在空正文时自动重试；在对话框成功发送消息后自动存成当前工作区的归档分段并按内容去重，自动保存的分段默认折叠，手动归档和发送按钮归档的分段默认展开；方向键只在分段文本的最开头 / 最末尾切换相邻分段（首行、末行中间列与软换行都不误跳），侧边栏工作区角标随当前笔记实时更新，保存成功后主动刷新其它会话的角标。 Detached-window mode opens the same workspace note in an independent, token-guarded loopback window that keeps working when DSH is minimized or its interface is closed; the floating panel hides while detached and returns from the restore pill, the header button, or the settings tab. 独立窗口模式把同一份工作区笔记移到一个由插件回环服务提供的独立窗口：DSH 最小化或关闭界面时仍可显示和编辑，浮窗在脱离期间收起，关闭独立窗口或点「收回面板」后自动恢复，设置页也可打开与收回。 App-window mode launches the local Edge / Chrome with --app for a dedicated window without tabs or an address bar; the Settings tab can switch back to a system browser window, and a missing browser falls back automatically. 应用窗口模式调用本机 Edge / Chrome 的 --app 打开无地址栏、无标签页的独立窗口；设置页可切回系统浏览器窗口，找不到浏览器时会自动回退。

Every DSH session is an independent AI with no awareness of the others; any session can host, set a topic and goal, invite the rest in order, and they speak one at a time until the rounds run out or the goal is met, then the meeting closes with written minutes. It doubles as a multi-agent game engine with targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks and elimination. Includes a beginner guide. items.name: dsh-git-graph-sidebar
items.description: Git commit graph chip plus a better-sidebar repository tab (SVG lane canvas, zoom, pinned commit card) that discovers the Git repositories up to three levels below the workspace directory and bootstraps a Git conventions document for each one and checks commit compliance against it; a conventions document is inherited by the repositories nested in it, conflicting and duplicated documents are reported to the agent, which reads them in full with its own file tools and writes the merged document itself, following the backup and inheritance-pointer rules the injected prompt carries - the plugin ships no merger. Users can also save, edit and delete their own convention templates from a settings page opened by the tab toolbar's gear; those templates live under the DSH home as one JSON store and appear after the seven built-in frameworks in the picker, while the built-ins stay read-only. The tab also lists linked worktrees as a read-only projection: it offers jumps and a status hand-off but never creates or removes one, so the single model-facing surface is a `git_worktree` fallback tool that creates, lists and removes managed worktrees and registers a new one as a workspace, and initializes a repository by writing the conventions document for it and installing a strict document's commit-msg hook so a bare `git commit` is checked too. Prose documents that state commit rules (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, CONTRIBUTING.md) next to the workspace or the repository are read with the same rule reader, so rules living outside the conventions document still reach the conflict report; those files are never rewritten. The same tab can also open as an opt-in, closable page in the conversation's main area, beside the shipped views.

items.name: API 体检
items.description: 配置前先体检 API：30 秒测出能不能用、快不快，以及坏在哪一层。
items.longDescription:
拿到一个陌生的 API 地址和 Key，先测一遍再决定要不要接进 Harness。左侧栏点「API 体检」，填两项，点一下按钮，30 秒给出结论：能用而且快，还是能用但慢，还是压根不通。

三个指标一起看：首字延迟、输出速度（tok/s）、连续 N 次的成功率。首字很快但成功率只有六成，说明线路在抖，比稳定地慢两秒更难受。

四层诊断，失败时归因到具体那一步：

1. 网络 —— 域名解析、端口连通、TLS 握手、证书剩余天数
2. Key 和模型 —— Key 是否有效；没填模型名时从该地址的 /models 里挑一个能对话的
3. 能不能真的说话 —— 走完整流式，把模型输出直接显示出来
4. 快不快稳不稳 —— 连测 N 次

每次失败都会标出卡在第几步，并报出实际写出去多少字节。「没反应」有两种完全相反的情况——TCP 都没建起来，一个字节都没发出去；和请求正文已经写出去了、对方连 HTTP 状态行都没回——混在一起就只能瞎猜。结论跟着证据走，不替服务商下结论。

37 个服务商预设，覆盖 OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic 原生、Gemini 原生和本地 Ollama / LM Studio。预设里不写死任何模型名：同一个模型在不同厂商的 ID 完全不同，中转站还会再改一次名，模型也会随时下架，过期的提示看起来很权威却会直接把人送进 400 错误。模型名一律取自该地址自己的 /models 响应。

Key 只在这一次请求里用一下，不写进任何文件，报告里打码，除被测的那家服务商外不发给任何第三方。

三套测试共 230 项（探测逻辑 129 / 客户端 75 / 路由 26），CI 跑 Node 20 与 24 × Linux 与 Windows，全绿。MIT。

源码与截图：https://github.com/LFY-bot/dsh-api-probe
需要 DeepSeek Harness >= 0.2.0-rc.2。

items.name: DSH Background · 多区域背景
items.description: 为全局、聊天和侧边栏设置独立图片背景，支持图库轮播、透明度与按比例缩放。
items.longDescription:
为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与官方 Desktop 设置图片背景。

- 全局、聊天与侧边栏分别配置图库、轮播间隔、透明度、模糊和单图样式。
- 右侧面板与左侧共用图库，独立选图，并可单独调整缩放与位置。
- 左右侧图片的透明度由宿主主题底色承接，不透出全局背景；关闭侧边栏图片或清空图库时仍可沿用全局背景。
- 支持高度铺满、宽度自适应，以及宽度铺满、高度自适应。
- 轨迹页面优先使用聊天背景；自动化任务页面沿用全局背景。
- Windows 顶部栏按下方区域显示背景，中间采用全局图片。
- 支持图片网址、本地图片导入及 JSON 配置导入导出；配置保存在当前客户端。

适配 Windows 10 / 11 x64、macOS Apple Silicon arm64 Preview 与 Linux x64 Preview 的官方 Desktop 客户端，也可在 Web 端使用。Windows 已有实机加载验证；macOS 与 Linux 已核对源码兼容性，尚未实机验证。

安装后从左侧「背景设置」或设置弹窗内「背景 / Background」进入，添加图片后保存即可生效。首次安装图库为空，不附带背景图片。

安装包包含已编译产物，无需安装时构建。详见 [使用说明](https://github.com/flora-ari/dsh-background#readme)。

items.name: MCP 工具管理器
items.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置里管理 MCP 服务器与工具：支持 streamable-http / stdio、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会注册进模型。
items.longDescription: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设置内的 MCP 服务器管理：添加 streamable-http（URL + 请求头）或 stdio（命令/参数/环境变量）服务器，请求头按 Postman 方式逐行填写并默认掩码；启用前可测试连通性并查看工具数量；每个工具是一个 chip，点击即从模型工具列表中移除，停用的工具不占上下文也无法被误调用。状态保存在本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-mcp-tools/state.json。

items.name: OpenWrite 小说创作
items.description: 小说创作工作台：创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注和审稿流程。
items.longDescription:
为 DeepSeek Harness web profile 提供小说创作工作台。作品保存在作者选择的本地目录，支持大纲、人物、正文批注与审稿流程。

首次使用下载并校验隔离 Python 环境，启动带实例认证的回环后端；不需要修改系统 Python。模型生成与评审使用用户配置的服务商，会产生相应 API 费用；安装与健康检查不调用写作模型。

推荐宿主 dsh 0.1.2-rc.1。macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64、Windows x64 原生验收见 Release 的 release-acceptance.json。0.1.5-alpha.1 仅按 docs/DSH_STORE.md 记录的依赖图验证。真实模型测量 not-run。

本条目通过 npm latest 安装预编译包，不依赖 GitHub 源码安装时的 prepare。latest 在执行安装/升级时解析；运行中不会自动更新。版本字段和验收记录对应已核验的 0.2.9，升级前请核对目标 Release 的宿主兼容范围。插件会下载依赖、读写选定作品并管理自身子进程；工具策略不是操作系统沙箱。卸载默认保留作品与历史。

items.name: dsh-plugin-agent-groups

items.longDescription:
把多个已打开的 DSH 会话组织成一个协作群：成员保留各自的上下文与角色设定，插件只采集每轮结束后的最终输出，按时间线排队，再合并投递。

- 不手工转发，不插入打断正在运行的会话；
- 成员忙时消息累积，空闲后一次性收到合并结果；
- 只转发最终结论，工具调用与中间过程不会进入时间线；
- 成员可输出【静默】跳过本轮，或输出【退出会话】离群；
- 右侧栏可固定查看群时间线。

items.name: Ponytail
items.description: 懒惰资深开发者人设：常驻最小编码规则集，lite/full/ultra/off 强度可切换，附 review/audit/debt/gain/help 五个代码审查技能。
items.longDescription:
把 DietrichGebert/ponytail（MIT）移植成 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。

- 每轮注入结构化规则集（Common + 不可删的 Safety 边界 + 档位专属规则），full 默认；
- `/ponytail` 报告/恢复，`/ponytail status` 只查询，`/ponytail lite|full|ultra|off` 显式切换；
- `/ponytail default <mode>` 持久化默认档（env / Profile config 仍优先）；
- Profile 级 `config: { defaultMode }`（web → full、tui → lite 等）；
- 五个一次性技能：`/ponytail-review`（改动审查）、`/ponytail-audit`（全仓库审计）、`/ponytail-debt`（债务台账）、`/ponytail-gain`（收益计分）、`/ponytail-help`（参考卡）；
- 说 `stop ponytail` 或 `normal mode` 停用；
- 常驻注入约 370–420 tokens/请求，同模式字节级稳定。

items.name: dsh-projects
items.description: Project and session organization for DeepSeek Harness: multi-folder projects, attention summaries, grouped chat search, and native folder picking.
items.longDescription: Organizes native DSH Workspace and Session data without migrating existing chats. Includes optional multi-folder project groups, compact or expanded attention summaries, grouped project/title/indexed-conversation search, pinning, favorites, manual ordering, an archive center, light/dark theme support, and native folder picking with a Web fallback. Alpha release — Windows Desktop is the primary real-world verified environment; macOS, Linux, and Web UI feedback is welcome.

items.name: 提示词改写
items.description: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，把草稿原地改写成目标、格式、约束齐全的可执行提示词；不发送、不弹预览窗，可按 Ctrl+Z 还原。
items.longDescription:
输入框里那句「帮我写个爬虫抓豆瓣电影」缺目标、缺格式、缺边界，模型只能猜。这个按钮把这三样补回你原本的句子里，改写结果**直接写回输入框**——不发送、不运行、不弹确认窗，就是一次普通编辑，`Ctrl+Z` 或点回退图标即可还原。

## 四态按钮

| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 空闲 | 静止鲸尾 |
| 改写中 | 鲸尾旋成螺旋，再点一下即取消，草稿保持原样 |
| 完成 | 变成回退箭头，一键还原 |
| 失败 | 红色重试图标，原因直接显示在图标旁，不用翻日志 |

## 其他行为

- **跨会话不中断**：点了按钮可以切走，任务继续跑完；回来时结果已写入。
- **上下文可选**：开关打开且本会话有历史时，会参考前文的目标与已排除方案。按钮右下角的蓝点表示「本次会参考上下文」。
- **只读输入框里的图片**：历史消息里的旧截图始终不读。
- **键盘快捷键**：默认关闭，打开后可录制自定义键位；桌面端 `Ctrl+E`，浏览器端 `Ctrl+Alt+E`，与点击图标完全等价。
- **设置页**：四项开关 + 一个模型下拉，只影响这个按钮，不影响正常发送。

## 要求

需要 DeepSeek Harness，`node >= 22`。装完需重启 Harness（本插件无 HMR）。

安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-rewriter`（桌面版把 `web` 换成 `desktop`）。

MIT。个人开源项目，与 DeepSeek 无隶属或授权关系。

items.description: Phone-first PWA for DeepSeek Harness: sessions, streaming chat, approvals on iOS and Android. No app install.
items.name: dsh-pwa
Radeon 容量
items.description: AMD Radeon Cloud 模型的忙闲度（AI Capacity）：模型选择器里每个模型一枚容量徽章，当前模型的容量就在模型名同一行。
items.longDescription:
在点下模型之前就知道它现在挤不挤。

AMD 控制台那根「AI Capacity」进度条的来源是 `GET /radeon/api/tokenfactory/load`，这个插件把它接到 DSH 的模型选择器上：

- **模型选择器**：每个 Radeon 模型名后一枚徽章，`● Idle 18%`（绿）/ `● Busy 63%`（橙）/ `● Full 100%`（红）
- **模型名同一行**：当前选中模型的容量读数，就在模型名左边 —— 和 WorkBuddy / Trae 挂积分的位置一致，而不是掉到输入框下方。选定模型、还没开始会话时同样显示
- **设置页**：已写入的模型连同实时容量逐条列出

徽章是**探测到 Radeon provider 之后才注册**的。没有 Radeon provider 时它根本不占那个槽，不会把内核自带的模型标注（含 1017 发布标记）顶掉。

**已经配好 Radeon provider 的人装完就有读数**：插件按 baseURL 里是否含 `developer.amd.com.cn` 认人，不看你把 provider 叫 `amd` 还是别的，也不管密钥引用叫什么，已有配置不需要改任何东西。

**顺带的配置能力**（可选）：可以在插件自己的设置页里一键把 provider 写进 DSH **用户层**配置 —— 写在用户层意味着**卸载本插件后 provider 依然可用**，不会出现「卸插件 = 删供应商」。也可以在插件里选收录哪些模型，未实测的新模型会以「不声明思考档位」的方式写入（猜档位会 400）。

**额度仅作展示**：网关会回 `x-ratelimit-*-user-daily-usd`，但 AMD 目前免费不限量，这个数不按它限量，所以只作参考值弱化显示，永远不 gate 调用。

界面读数一律英文（`Idle / Busy / Full` 是 AMD 控制台自己的术语），设置页中英双语跟随界面语言。

44 项测试全绿（含把客户端 bundle 真加载一遍的界面集成测试）。MIT。

源码与说明：https://github.com/lcy362/dsh-radeon-capacity
需要 DeepSeek Harness >= 0.2.0-rc.1。

items.name: 会话分类（Session Categories）
items.description: 把 DSH 会话划进分类、在分类下新建会话，并在每轮对话结束后用 AI 判定该归哪一类、标题是否该改。
items.longDescription:
给 DSH Web 界面加一层「会话分类」。

- **划入分类**：任意会话归入某个分类，原生侧边栏行首出现分类色条。
- **在分类下新建会话**：点分类标题右侧的 `+`，新建的空白会话直接归入该分类。
- **AI 自动分类**：每轮结束后后台判断该归哪一类、标题是否还能靠它找回来，建议以 chip 形式出现在输入框工具行，点一下采纳或忽略。
- **侧边栏按分类筛选**：工作区列表上方的漏斗按钮，用原生列表过滤，不替换原生组件。
- **归档 / 搜索 / 花费台账**：归档分类独立成视图；面板支持搜索、分类跳转条、吸顶标题，并记录每次模型调用的花费（可设上限）。

无构建步骤、无运行时依赖（peer 依赖由宿主提供）。状态只写在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-session-categories/state.json`，不写任何会话日志。

仓库：https://github.com/CleverYyt/dsh-session-categories

items.name: DSH BTW
items.description: 在主输入框上方使用原生弹窗，借助当前会话上下文进行旁聊与追问，主任务可继续运行。
items.longDescription:
The sole entry point is `/btw`. Native history and follow-up controls stay above the main composer. It preserves the main request prefix and cache affinity for possible provider cache reuse. Side requests do not execute tools or append to the main conversation. The latest 20 side exchanges per main conversation live only in this window memory and disappear on reload. It uses the existing model provider with normal provider usage charges; actual cache hits depend on the provider.

Targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 exactly, Cordis 4.0.5 and Node.js 22.19+. Verified on macOS with the real release runtime in an isolated native DSH Web profile: package installation, /btw entry, native popover/history/follow-up interactions, independent cancellation and main-conversation preservation. Four focused tests and the main/tag CI passed. Windows, Linux and Electron desktop device flows have not been tested. Cache reuse preserves the main request prefix and provider affinity, but actual cache hits depend on the provider.

items.longDescription:
Three native Appearance pages cover settings, theme management and four visual market sources. Includes six appearances and 29 palettes, discovery of existing themes without duplicate installation, automatic preparation of source packages, current-host version selection, native backend/configuration lifecycles, recovery and AI repair guidance. Host/adapter changes trigger affected-theme revalidation. Catalog inclusion does not establish compatibility.

Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 exactly, Cordis 4.0.5 and Node.js 22.19+. Version 0.2.0 uses real native theme backends, configuration validation/persistence and isolated pre-install checks. A fixed 549-entry catalog snapshot was prepared and runnable candidates exercised individually on macOS: 454 passed basic runtime checks; 95 remained blocked, including obsolete interfaces, missing resources and runtime faults. Real market installation of dsh-ads and ORCA Link, native configuration writes, restart recovery and coinstallation were verified. Windows/Linux devices and every additional feature or plugin combination are not verified. Theme backends retain normal Node/DSH capabilities; preflight is not a malicious-code sandbox.

items.name: harness-lark
items.description: Lark/飞书（Feishu）渠道插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供飞书通信能力。
items.longDescription:
# harness-lark

Lark/飞书（Feishu）渠道插件，为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供飞书通信能力。通信部分参考 [openclaw-lark](https://github.com/larksuite/openclaw-lark)（MIT, ByteDance Ltd.），适配 dsh 的 Cordis 插件体系。

English | [中文](README.zh.md) | [📖 安装文档（GitHub Pages）](https://huoxue1.github.io/harness-lark/)

> 用 Docker 一键部署（自带插件的 `deepseek-harness-lark` 镜像）或手动安装插件，见[安装文档](https://huoxue1.github.io/harness-lark/)。

## 功能

| 类别 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| 💬 IM 消息收发 | WebSocket 长连接接收消息、文本/卡片回复、@提及、群聊/私聊策略、重连去重 |
| 🃏 交互卡片 + 流式回复 | 思考过程（reasoning）流式 → 生成（answer）流式 → 最终结果更新到卡片，含可折叠思考面板、耗时/token footer |
| 🖼️ 媒体 | 图片/文件/音频的上传、下载与发送 |
| 📄 文档/Wiki/Drive | 创建/读取/更新云文档（docx）、知识库节点、云盘文件 |
| 📊 Base/表格/日历/任务 | 多维表格（bitable）、电子表格、日历事件、任务 |
| 🔐 用户 OAuth | 设备授权码流程（RFC 8628），用户级 token 管理 |
| 👍 表情反馈 | 收到消息回复 `Get` 表情（处理中），完成后换成 `DONE` |
| 🔐 飞书审批卡片 | dsh 审批请求（如 bash 沙箱升级）以带「批准/拒绝」按钮的卡片发到会话，点击即应答，超时自动拒绝 |
| ⌨️ 斜杠命令 | `/status` `/model` `/cd` `/permission` `/setting` `/help` 本地命令（不进模型） |

## 架构

- **会话模型**：每个飞书会话（chat_id）映射一个持久的 dsh agent（`ctx.agents.resume` 优先，失败则 `create`），上下文跨消息、跨重启保留。
- **通信层**：`@larksuiteoapi/node-sdk` 的 `WSClient` 长连接 + `EventDispatcher` 路由（参考 openclaw-lark 的 `monitor.ts` / `lark-client.ts`）。注意 SDK v1.65+ 需要显式 `start({ eventDispatcher })`（旧版构造时自动连接），且事件为 schema 2.0 格式（`message.message_type` 而非 `msg_type`）——harness-lark 两者均已适配。
- **回复通路**：飞书消息 → `agent.followup()`；`assistant/chunk`（reasoning-delta / text-delta）→ 流式卡片；`turn/end` → 完成卡片并换表情。
- **模型切换**：`/model` 通过 `installModelSelection` 的 `ModelSelectionRef` 运行时改写，下一轮生效。
- **工具注册**：所有飞书能力以 dsh 工具（`ctx.tools.register` + `defineTool`）暴露给模型。

## 斜杠命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `/status` | 查看当前模型、工作目录、会话状态 |
| `/model` | 列出可用模型；`/model <provider/model>` 切换 |
| `/cd` | 查看工作目录；`/cd <绝对路径>` 修改（下次会话/重启后生效） |
| `/new` | 新建上下文（清空当前对话历史，别名 `/reset`） |
| `/stop` | 停止当前正在进行的回复 |
| `/permission` | 查看/切换会话权限预设（`/permission <预设名>`，如 `danger-full-access`） |
| `/setting` | 查看设置项；`/setting permission [预设名]` 设置新会话默认权限；`/setting model [模型]` 设置新会话默认模型 |
| `/help` | 列出所有命令 |

群聊中命令可带 `@机器人` 前缀（如 `@机器人 /status`），插件会自动剥离提及前缀。

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Node.js ≥ 22（含 pnpm）
- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh` CLI，可通过 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 或从源码运行）
- 飞书开放平台应用（凭据：`appId`、`appSecret`；推荐开启长连接模式，无需公网回调地址）
- 飞书开放平台后台：事件订阅 → 订阅方式选择「使用长连接接收事件」，并订阅 `im.message.receive_v1` 事件

### 一条命令安装（推荐）

harness-lark 已发布到 npm。插件声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh plugin` 安装后会自动把
插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 作为 bundle 层应用——**无需再手动编辑任何配置**，凭据直接读环境变量：

```sh
# 1. 设置凭据
export FEISHU_APP_ID=cli_xxx
export FEISHU_APP_SECRET=your_secret

# 2. 安装到 web profile（同时自动应用插件的 cordis.patch.yml）
dsh plugin --profile web add harness-lark

# 3. 启动
dsh --profile web
```

可选：用仓库提供的一键脚本（安装 + 启动，等价于上面三条命令）：

```sh
export FEISHU_APP_ID=cli_xxx
export FEISHU_APP_SECRET=your_secret
bash scripts/install-dsh.sh web harness-lark
```

> 用本地源码构建后安装：`bash scripts/install-dsh.sh web /path/to/harness-lark`
> （先在仓库目录执行 `pnpm install && pnpm run build`）

> 想覆盖插件默认配置（如禁用群聊）时，在 profile 的 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`
> 中按 `id: lark` 覆盖对应字段即可（见下方配置示例）。

### 方式二：手动 patch 安装（从源码）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/huoxue1/harness-lark.git
cd harness-lark
pnpm install && pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/harness-lark
```

或直接在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`）中加入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lark
      name: 'harness-lark'
      config:
        appId: !!js process.env.FEISHU_APP_ID
        appSecret: !!js process.env.FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        brand: feishu        # feishu | lark
        connectionMode: websocket
        dmPolicy: open       # open | pairing | allowlist | disabled
        groupPolicy: disabled
        requireMentionInGroups: true
        replyMode: streaming # auto | static | streaming
```

> 群聊允许 + 流式回复：`groupPolicy: open`、`requireMentionInGroups: false`、`replyMode: streaming`。

### 方式三：Docker 部署

参见仓库内 `Dockerfile` / `docker-compose.yml`（dsh 侧镜像），插件通过 `COPY plugins/harness-lark` 打进镜像，entrypoint 首次启动时用 `dsh plugin --profile web add` 装入 profile。

## 配置

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appId` | string | — | 飞书应用 ID（缺省时仅注册工具、不启动网关） |
| `appSecret` | string | — | 飞书应用密钥（缺省时仅注册工具、不启动网关） |
| `encryptKey` | string | — | 事件加密密钥（长连接模式可留空） |
| `verificationToken` | string | — | 事件验证令牌（长连接模式可留空） |
| `brand` | `feishu` \| `lark` | `feishu` | 平台品牌 |
| `connectionMode` | `websocket` \| `webhook` | `websocket` | 事件接收模式 |
| `provider` | string | — | 创建的 agent 使用的 provider（缺省走默认） |
| `model` | string | — | 创建的 agent 使用的模型 |
| `replyMode` | `auto` \| `static` \| `streaming` | `auto` | 回复模式（`auto` 走静态文本） |
| `dmPolicy` | `open` \| `pairing` \| `allowlist` \| `disabled` | `open` | 私聊策略 |
| `groupPolicy` | `open` \| `allowlist` \| `disabled` | `disabled` | 群聊策略 |
| `allowlist` | string[] | — | open_id 白名单 |
| `requireMentionInGroups` | boolean | `true` | 群聊中是否需要 @机器人 |
| `topicSeparateSession` | boolean | `false` | 话题群消息按 thread 独立建 session（每个话题一个上下文） |
| `dedupTtlMs` | number | 12h | 消息去重窗口 |
| `agents` | array | — | 多 agent 配置（见下）：每个 agent 一个 chat 路由分区 |

### 多 Agent 配置（`agents`）

支持多个 agent（可共享同一个飞书应用的 `appId`/`appSecret`），按 chat 路由：

```yaml
- id: lark
  config:
    agents:
      - id: agent-a
        appId: cli_xxx            # 可与其他 agent 共享同一 appId/secret
        appSecret: secret
        cwd: /work/a              # 该 agent 会话的默认工作目录
        agentsMd: |               # 写入 <cwd>/AGENTS.md，作为该 agent 的指令
          # agent-a 的专属指令
        chats: [oc_111, p2p]      # 限定该 agent 服务的 chat：oc_ 精确 id 或 p2p/group 标签
        default: true             # 默认 agent：未匹配其他 agent 的 chat 走它
      - id: agent-b
        appId: cli_xxx            # 共享同一应用
        appSecret: secret
        cwd: /work/b
        agentsMd: "..."
        chats: [oc_222, group]    # 只服务该群组
```

- `chats`：`oc_...` 精确 chat_id 或 `p2p`/`group` 类型标签；缺省 = 服务全部（仅限单 agent 组）。
- `default: true`：未匹配的 chat 路由到此 agent；未标记时取组内第一个。
- 同一 `appId` 的 agent 共享一条 WebSocket 连接，消息按 chat 路由到各自 bridge（独立 cwd/AGENTS.md/session）。
- 也可在 Web 设置界面（dsh settings 的 `harness-lark` namespace）编辑 `agents`，重启后生效。
- 旧的顶层 `appId`/`appSecret`（或 `FEISHU_APP_ID`/`FEISHU_APP_SECRET` 环境变量）仍兼容，作为单 agent 配置。

## 工具清单

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `feishu_create_doc` | 从 Markdown 创建云文档 |
| `feishu_fetch_doc` | 读取云文档（Markdown） |
| `feishu_update_doc` | 向云文档追加 Markdown |
| `feishu_wiki_space_node` | 列出知识库节点 |
| `feishu_drive_file` | 搜索/列出云盘文件 |
| `feishu_bitable_app` / `_table` / `_record` / `_field` / `_view` | 多维表格操作 |
| `feishu_sheet` | 电子表格创建/读取/写入 |
| `feishu_calendar_event` | 日历事件 CRUD |
| `feishu_task_task` | 任务 CRUD/完成 |
| `feishu_oauth` | 用户 OAuth 授权/状态/撤销 |

> 用户数据类工具（云文档 `feishu_create_doc`/`fetch_doc`/`update_doc`，以及多维表格、电子表格、日历、任务系列工具）在用户执行 `/feishu auth` 授权后，以该用户的身份调用飞书 API；未授权时回退为机器人身份。Wiki/Drive/IM 类工具始终以机器人身份调用。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm run test        # vitest
pnpm run build       # tsdown -> lib/
```

### 目录结构

```
src/
  index.ts                 # 插件入口（name/inject/Config/apply）
  core/                    # 配置 schema、LarkClient、类型、去重、OAuth、token store
  channel/                 # WebSocket 网关 + 事件处理
  messaging/inbound/       # 消息解析、@提及、去重
  messaging/outbound/      # 文本/卡片/媒体发送
  agent/bridge.ts          # per-chat 持久 agent 桥接
  card/                    # 交互卡片构建 + 流式控制器
  tools/                   # 文档/Wiki/Drive、Base/表格/日历/任务、OAuth 工具
tests/                     # vitest 单测
```

## 安全说明

与 OpenClaw 插件相同，此插件在授权范围内以机器人身份调用飞书 API，存在模型幻觉、提示注入等固有风险。建议仅作为私聊助手使用，不要加入群聊或允许他人交互；保持默认安全配置（`groupPolicy: disabled`、`requireMentionInGroups: true`）。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)。通信与卡片设计参考 [openclaw-lark](https://github.com/larksuite/openclaw-lark)（MIT, ByteDance Ltd.）。

items.name: 图片/视频/语音生成调度
items.description: 给文本模型补上出图、出视频、出语音的能力，多模型池调度，失败自动降级和熔断，零依赖纯标准库
items.longDescription:
文本模型遇到「生成一张图」「做个视频」「配段旁白」这类步骤时只会说「我做不到」，任务就断在那里。media-router 用一个你自己维护的多模型池把这一步接上：挑模型、调接口、下载产物，再把产物路径和文字描述交回给文本模型，原任务继续往下走。

模型池写在 `config/models.yaml`，`priority` 决定档位、`weight` 决定同档内的概率；失败自动换下一个候选，缺密钥的模型跳过且不占重试次数；同一模型连续失败到阈值（默认 3 次）进入冷却，成功后计数清零。图片 / 视频池各带一条 `native` 兜底，真模型全不可用时返回「请调用内置 ImageGen / VideoGen」的委托指令，没配 Key 也不会卡死。

v1.3.0 起支持语音：语音生成走 dashscope（qwen-audio / qwen3-tts / cosyvoice）、openai（含智谱 GLM-TTS、硅基流动 CosyVoice2）、kling（`/audio/tts` 异步）、volcengine（豆包语音流式）四条通路；`--count N` 对语音同样生效，产物按类目落 `outputs/image|video|audio/`。

命令行 `--param key=value` 会原样透传给接口（不再被白名单丢掉）；提交类请求在网络超时后不会自动重发，避免重复计费；下载失败时错误 JSON 会带回产物 `urls`、不熔断也不换模型重跑。

需要 Python 3.8+，零第三方依赖。在 DSH 里可以直接从插件市场一键安装，装完落在 `~/.agents/skills/media-router/`，新开一个会话就能用；手动安装则把目录复制到 agent 的 skills 目录并改名为 `media-router`（`~/.dsh/skills/`、`~/.claude/skills/`、`~/.codex/skills/`）。

不想手写 YAML 就开网页配置台，配厂商、粘 Key、拖权重滑块，点「测试连通性」验密钥不花钱：

```bash
python3 scripts/media_router.py web
```

习惯命令行的走这条：

```bash
python3 scripts/media_router.py list --pretty
export ARK_API_KEY="你的-key"
python3 scripts/media_router.py generate --kind image --prompt "一只戴圆框眼镜的橘猫"
python3 scripts/media_router.py generate --kind audio --prompt "你好，欢迎使用。"
```

返回的 JSON 里 `files[0].path` 就是产物的绝对路径。密钥存在 `config/secrets.yaml`，已在 `.gitignore` 里，不会进版本库。

完整文档：https://github.com/vibe-weaver/media-router-skill

items.name: dsh-llm-auto
items.description: DSH 宿主插件:注册一个 `auto` 模型路由,内部按配置的有序链依次尝试多条「provider + model」;某条在**产出任何内容之前**失败时,先按官方同款策略在该路由内原地重试(瞬时错误白名单,默认 5 次),重试耗尽才静默切下一条,对上层表现为一个普通模型;并可用 compactWindow 把自动压缩点钉在指定 token 数附近。0.4.0 起自带浏览器半侧:插件页该 bundle 的卡片上直接渲染配置表单,可直接改 compactWindow(官方 SettingsForm 原语,保存才写入)。0.5.0 起同一处再渲染只读「回退链」面板:当前生效链 + 最近若干次请求的真实回退过程(数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes,打开页面时读一次、可手动刷新)。0.5.2 起:DeepSeek 原生路由可用 routes[i].keepThinking 保留工具循环思考,缺省仍摘;(B1/B2) 跨路由的历史思考改为从 content 与 replayState.blocks 同步摘掉,不再被上游降级成正文;(B) 真的发生静默路由切换时,在出站消息末尾追加一条与 DSH 自带同款的 model changed 通知(只改出站负载、不写会话记录)。0.5.3 起:新增 routes[i].breakToolLoop —— 历史里存在「带工具调用却没有思考块」的助手消息、且出站以工具结果结尾时,在出站消息末尾追加一条用户提示,把请求改成「以用户消息结尾」,绕开 DeepSeek thinking 模式的工具循环校验(这种情形下思考是「从来没有」,keepThinking 挡不住)。0.6.0 起:routes 成为可写配置,插件页那张卡片上的「回退链」面板升级成可编辑 —— 拖拽排序、从 live 模型目录(新增 GET /api/llm-auto/catalog)里选模型、按行开关 keepThinking/breakToolLoop;写入走官方设置服务落进 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml(注释保留),靠懒读 volatile 引用免重启生效。0.7.0 起:同一张卡片上再多一段**只读**的「额度」摘要 —— 链上两家订阅的余额/窗口用量(Command Code 的美元余额 + 5h/周窗口,OpenCode Go 的 5h/周/月三档百分比),数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes 新增的 quota 字段;宿主侧只读查询、按 TTL 缓存、永不因此改变端点状态码,**查不到就显示「不可查」而不是 0**;同一个响应里还在确有 profile 覆盖时多一个 user.routes,让面板的「恢复包内默认链」按钮终于有判据可依。0.8.0 起:回退链的顺序改由插件**按订阅额度自动决定** —— 有月度重置时刻的订阅按「越早重置越靠前」排,查不到重置时刻的按配置顺序,永不过期的按量兜底排最后;某一跳因窗口额度耗尽被拒(错误码 QUOTA)时,插件补查该来源的额度接口,确认后把它冷却到对应窗口的重置时刻、期间不再尝试,到点自动恢复(进程内冷却表,不落盘)。新增 volatile 配置键 ordering.mode(auto 默认 / manual = 回到 0.7.0 的「完全按 routes 顺序」),插件页那张卡片上多一段「自动排序」摘要与开关;/routes 响应新增只读字段 ordering(effective 实际尝试顺序 + cooldown 冷却表),chain 仍是配置顺序。0.9.0 起:插件页那张卡片的界面**按排序模式收敛** —— 模式开关(自动/手动)挪到卡片最上面、在「回退链」标题之前;自动模式下主视图是「生效顺序」(插件排出来的实际尝试顺序),可编辑的配置链折进默认收起的「配置顺序」折叠项(点开照旧可拖可改),提示语也换成「自动排序生效中」那句;手动模式下主视图就是那条可编辑的链,不画生效顺序。0.9.1 起:放宽「窗口额度耗尽」判据 —— 不再要求 `usage limit` 紧跟 exhausted/reached(Command Code 的实际文案是 `You've reached your weekly usage limit for your plan. Your limit resets at …`,旧判据对它返回 false,于是每次请求都先白撞 CC 并原地重试 6 次),改为「窗口词 + 额度词 + 耗尽/重置词三者同时成立」;该判据由宿主侧(补查额度、冷却该 provider)与适配器侧(不再原地重试,直接切下一条)共用同一个函数。0.10.0 起:`auto` 在模型选择器的档位面板上只有两档 ——「Default」(插件一个推理档位都不写,交回宿主/上游默认)与「max」(逐条路由取该家最高档,与 0.9.x 的旧行为逐字等价);声明面是 `resolveModel()` 的 `reasoning.efforts=[max]` 且**不给** `defaultEffort`(给了就没有 Default 那行)。⚠ 要让「默认档」真的不带推理强度,pi-ai 路由的 profile 里不能有 route 级 `reasoning:` —— 本机 2026-10-09 已从 desktop / headless 两个 profile 删掉。0.11.0 起:冷却表**落盘** —— 结论写进宿主领域存储(域 llm_auto_cooldown / 表 cooldowns,介质 <DSH_HOME>/storages/llm_auto_cooldown.json),跨 dsh 重启与插件重组合存活到重置时刻,不再有「重启后第一条白撞」;被 QUOTA 拒的当下先同步记一条 5 分钟短闸门(补查确认后换成重置时刻),周期补查见该家已恢复则自动解冻,面板冷却行右侧多一个「解除」按钮(走设置服务的 ordering.unfreeze 一次性指令,不新增写端点),并显示冷却表落盘状态;存储服务缺席 / 打开失败 / 写入失败一律降级为纯内存 + warn,绝不影响注册与请求。0.11.1 起:把「解除冷却」指令的**已消费记录也落盘** —— 面板写进配置的那条 ordering.unfreeze 值一变就生效,但面板自己**不会清掉它**,而 0.11.0 只把「消费过了」记在内存里 ⇒ 宿主重启后旧指令会被当成新指令再消费一次(清冷却 + 删介质记录 + 第一条请求又白撞那家,2026-10-12 真机实测:撞 Go 948 ms 被判 QUOTA → 切走 → 6 秒后介质被重写成 source=confirm)。0.11.1 把这个值写进冷却域(域 llm_auto_cooldown)的 global 槽 —— 不改域名 / version / cooldowns 表结构,老介质(global: null)照旧能打开 —— 水合时读回来,同一个值永不再触发。另加一条**陈旧判据**:指令里的 epochMs 早于宿主**进程**启动时刻 ⇒ 只记为已消费、不做任何解除动作并 warn(面板不可能在宿主没运行时被点到;用进程启动时刻而不是插件 apply 时刻,免得重组合把合法点击误判成陈旧);配置里现存的那条旧指令因此在升级后的第一次重启也不会再撞一次。已知代价:宿主停机期间(或点完还没被消费就重启)的「解除」不会被事后补偿,重启后再点一次即可;写 global 失败 / 读不出来都只 warn,冷却水合照旧。

items.name: @dsh-external/project-nav
items.description: DSH plugin: architecture-first project governance, FOR AGENTS ONLY. v0.12.0 made governance PRESENT instead of merely callable: the three persisted projections (PROJECT.md marker section / .internal/ARCH-MODEL.md / HTML map) are gone — their only reader was a human — and governance moved into the agent's context via a presence layer. v0.12.1 collapses that layer to a SINGLE injection path: the `systemPrompt.section` whose text is a FUNCTION evaluated every turn. The second path (tools/post-execute + additionalContexts) was removed because it was pure duplication (the per-turn section already carries the latest governance; measured 24 duplicate inbox injections / ~31KB in a real session log) AND because it was the only thing that created a message — and a message's `source` is load-bearing (a missing one makes a downstream `agent/pre-step` read `source.kind` of undefined, throwing and turning the whole turn into `turn/end {kind:'error'}`). The section never creates a message, so deleting that path removes the entire failure class rather than patching one instance of it. Output is zero-on-disk: nav_graph computes on demand and the presence layer injects, both pure derivations of the model. The presence layer reads ONLY the event-log fold (measured 5.1ms vs 177ms for the full disk-scanning buildModel, 35x), never writes runtime/, and refuses to report disk facts it did not compute. Data plane 2 layers, tool face 5 (nav_render retired with the projections). The model is a TREE + GRAPH — the containment tree (who belongs to whom) sits beside a dependency graph (who imports whom) DERIVED from a static import scan: never registered, never hand-written, never stale. Seven gates (anchor / scope / mainline / impact / repeat-patch / decision / completion) are pure queries inside the single write entry point nav_commit, so there is no begin/done lifecycle and no orphan state: closure is decided by EVIDENCE (did the scope files change?), never by session identity — kill a session and its intent still closes (A1). ONE append-only event log (.internal/events.jsonl) is the single source of truth; the runtime model (incl. the dependency graph) is disposable — delete runtime/ and governance loses nothing (I3). Tool face 5: nav_graph (read, incl. mode=impact / mode=json) / nav_commit (intent) / nav_decide (ADR) / nav_node (nodes) / nav_set (mainline vector).

items.name: dsh-plugin-cicd
items.description: 发布台（Release Console）for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a full main-panel page that show what each repository has built, what it has released, whether the local checkout is ahead of the release, whether the copy installed in this profile is the published artifact, and which version npm holds. 发布 is one press that does the whole release (发布同台): push the code, bump the version when the workflow would refuse it, dispatch release.yml asking for a draft, wait for that run, push npm, then make the draft public, then announce on Bilibili. The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. The separate buttons remain for a repository whose release must stay a draft. It also carries the third channel: when a release goes public, one short update note is posted under the video that introduces the plugin, with the credential obtained from a Bilibili sign-in inside the panel. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and the Host's own package manager, so the plugin stores no GitHub or npm credential of its own; the one credential it does own is the Bilibili session it created, kept in its own directory and never echoed back.

Channel data is a three-layer catalog (shipped <- remote JSON <- local override) so new channels arrive without a release; a version check covers plugin upgrades. Every channel carries a readiness state and an actionable reason instead of a button that always fails.

items.description: 对话围栏：一套对所有对话生效的通用规则 + 可选的按对话追加的专属规则，全部存在一个位置可自定义的 JSON 文件里，以固定顺序注入运行时上下文快照（不破坏前缀缓存、纯追加、压缩后仍存活）。每条规则右侧有独立开关可随时单独停用；还可以勾选「不使用围栏的对话」让若干对话整体跳过围栏（规则保留，取消勾选即恢复）。按标准 DSH bundle 安装，出现在「插件 → 已安装」，可用官方安装器装卸；规则可在设置页、包详情页与会话浮层里编辑。 / A dialogue fence: a shared rule list that applies to every conversation plus an optional per-session list, stored in one JSON file whose location is customizable, injected into the runtime-context snapshot at a fixed order (cache-safe, append-only, compression-durable). Every rule carries its own on/off switch, and a per-session exclusion list lets chosen conversations skip the fence entirely (their rules stay intact and come back when unchecked). Installs as a normal DSH bundle, so it shows up under Plugins -> Installed and can be installed/removed with the official installer; rules are edited on the Settings page, in its own bundle page, and in the conversation panel.

items.name: dsh-workflow-runner
items.description: Run ZCode-style Dynamic Workflows inside dsh (DeepSeek Harness). Workflows are TypeScript scripts analysed at compile time (site / causality / control-flow / hand-off graphs) and lowered to instrumented JS with stable site ids, so every agent.ask carries a typed result contract synthesized from ask<T> generics. The engine is ZCode's own @zcode/dynamic-workflow, vendored unmodified. On top of it: parallel LLM agents with real chat history, shell gates, artifact deliverables (file / markdown / chart / table / metrics / board), workspace file and git reads, in-process channel/future concurrency with a per-run ceiling, model routing, mid-run human questions, mid-run code injection (hole<T>), structural amend that injects a stage into a live run, escalate() with Think-via-LLM, saved workflows, snippet evaluation, on-disk run history, a per-run max_concurrency ceiling, explicit phase lifecycle events, channel-deadlock detection, and an OS-level sandbox whose path fences are enforced at the single world-read choke point. Live progress streams to the chat UI as overlay cards.

items.name: dsh-task-console
items.description: DSH client plugin — flip to the back of the page for a floating glass task console: live background jobs, subagents, session overview and workspace of the current session, with mouse-draggable and mouse-resizable cards (bottom-right handle, size persisted per card). Maximizing a card unrolls its controls onto the card's own canvas, where every control is a draggable, editable item and the board card stays a live thumbnail whose control order follows that arrangement; built-in cards open as a fullscreen view. The top-right card conversation calls a temporary agent session to refactor each card's style and internal controls from natural language, and any conversation can author cards via [taskcard] blocks (text/heading/note/stats/progress/trend/kv/links/chips/checklist/counter/button/table/code/toggle/countdown/bars/image/embed). Embedded web apps can be marked 受控 and routed through the bundled local page bridge (bridge/server.mjs), which injects an agent into the page so the workbench — and the agent — can click, type, scroll and read inside it through [page] action blocks; the app height is dragged on its bottom edge, accurate on the zoomed canvas too. Cards can be published as copies onto a fullscreen infinite canvas with named boards, share strings and a zero-dependency WebSocket relay for multi-user editing, and a right-hand dock renders the project's archify architecture diagram (embedded, sandboxed, resizable).

items.name: dsh-power
items.description: Restart and shut down DSH from the page: ONE draggable card injected by the host whose artwork carries two hit zones (left = shut down, right = restart); the first click only asks (the card turns into a yes/no question), the second click on either half (or the middle seam) actually fires — two clicks are already the safety catch, so the pending question is sticky and a second click never re-targets the other action. Esc or a click outside cancels. Plus a multi-instance-safe restart engine that stops only the current instance's tree (no more killing other DSH instances), waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object, confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route (the core /health route is behind the web token, so it cannot be used), watches it stay up, and brings the new window to the foreground so you can see the restart finished.

items.name: dsh-pavement-design-methods
items.description: An entire Chinese monograph on pavement design methods (9 usable chapters, 76 capability cards) distilled into one skill entry. The book's two design chapters contain NO reproducible worked example, and its only complete hand calculation ends with a wrong verdict -- this package makes that the core deliverable instead of hiding it. Covers design-method selection (China's seven editions, AASHTO, CBR, AI, Shell), indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion, climate zoning, material moduli, and the failure boundaries of five generations of mechanical models. Chapter 9 (airport pavements) was replaced by unrelated textbook content during an earlier transcription, then recovered on 2026-10-24 by re-OCR of the intact PDF: 10 cards, including the only fully reproducible worked example in the book. Its 45 figure numbers still have no figure content, and three slab-thickness formulas remain broken.

items.name: dsh-pavement-skid-resistance
items.description: An entire Chinese monograph on asphalt-pavement skid resistance (12 chapters, 591 pages) distilled into one skill entry: 76 capability cards covering friction and adhesion calibers, water film and the three hydroplaning types, texture and texture depth, tyre-road contact and skid testing, multi-condition adhesion, vehicle stability and skid prediction, porous drainage asphalt, seal coats and maintenance decisions. Every card states when NOT to use it, and the package refuses to produce a number the source cannot support rather than inventing one. About a dozen defects in the book itself -- two tables carrying identical data for differently sized specimens, a passage whose two halves point in opposite directions, a chapter whose prose never addresses its title -- are documented as the package's own contribution. Ships with a 12-question blind-test log.

items.name: dsh-pavement-structural-dynamics
items.description: An entire Chinese monograph on pavement structural dynamics (8 chapters, 204 pages) distilled into one skill entry: 59 capability cards covering dynamics fundamentals, dynamic material parameters, asphalt pavement response under moving loads, plate-on-elastic-foundation theory, FWD detection and modulus back-calculation, fatigue and fracture, and steel-bridge-deck paving. This is a judgement manual, not a calculator: every card states when NOT to use it, and the package refuses to produce a number the source cannot support. Four of the eight chapters promise more than they deliver (a structural-dynamics chapter mentioning pavement twice, a rigid-pavement chapter with zero mentions of joints or voids, a fatigue chapter with no life calculation at all), and that mismatch is documented as the package's own contribution together with roughly a hundred transcription defects. Ships with a 12-question blind-test log.

items.name: dsh-road-building-materials
items.description: An entire Chinese textbook on road building materials (12 chapters, 60 capability cards) distilled into one skill entry. This is a MATERIAL-CALIBER manual, not a pass/fail checker: its deliverable is 'under what conditions does this number hold', not 'is this material acceptable'. Covers aggregate density families and gradation, asphalt penetration/softening-point/ductility and the PG system, asphalt-mix volumetric parameters and Marshall mix design, cement strength grade and soundness, concrete and mortar mix proportioning, inorganic-binder stabilized mixtures and their 7d strength, steel grades, engineering polymers, and the 35 test procedures of the book's second part. Contains three direction errors that will judge non-conforming material as conforming if copied, five worked examples that cannot be reproduced (two of which must never be quoted), and two places where the OCR fabricated figure data with invented coordinates.

items.name: source-code-mgmt
items.description: DSH plugin: source code management. Registers「代码管理」as a card in DSH's OWN right sidebar (the official guide page, beside 工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器) and as a tab page in that column — there is no separate button. Older hosts degrade gracefully: dsh-better-sidebar (if installed) gets a Tab; a host with neither gets a header entry (beside "Session log", plus a same-height pinned one in the empty state). Nothing is ever placed in DSH's own left sidebar. The SSH section lets you choose port 443 (through firewalls that block 22) or the standard 22, and switching rewrites ~/.ssh/config in place. Repo status batches its git calls (one numstat for all changed files, one `remote -v` for name+URL), cutting a load on a busy repo from ~1.3s to ~0.06s. Opens a panel with env checks (git/gh), SSH ed25519 key setup, GitHub/Gitee dual-platform (SSH config + Gitee OpenAPI), connectivity test, push / new repo, auto-ignore files over 100MB with per-file skipped reasons, a clone section (remote repos from your account with local-exists detection, plus clone any repo by URL into any location), and a five-step npm publish wizard. Cross-platform (Windows / Linux / macOS).

items.name: dsh-narrow-screen-fix
items.description: Unified narrow-screen (mobile) CSS adaptation for the dsh web GUI, replacing dsh-question-footer-fix / dsh-composer-send-fix / dsh-nav-tabs-scroll-fix. Fixes: question card + plan review footer overflow, send-button inset, top tab bar horizontal scroll, settings panel mobile stacking, directory browser columns, ssh panel tab bar, **model select dropdown menu re-anchored to a bottom-sheet on phones** (iOS ActionSheet-style: position:fixed, full-width inside 8px gutter, max-height:65vh). Pure CSS — no JS path needed; earlier v0.3.0/0.3.1 included a JS reparent-to-body helper that broke the model's closeOutside/onBlur handlers (they gate on `rootRef.contains(target)`, and reparenting moved the menu out of root), which is why the second-level pane (model list / effort level) failed to open — clicks inside the now-detached menu were treated as outside-click and closed it. v0.3.2 removes the JS path entirely; pure CSS bottom-sheet is sufficient. All via client-side style override — no dsh sources touched. 中文：DSH 窄屏适配统一插件（纯 client 覆盖样式）。

items.name: cordis-plugin-novelist
items.description: File-backed book ledger tools for long-form fiction, shipped in two host forms from one source of truth. Fifteen deterministic novel_* tools read and write one directory per book: JSON ledgers (project/bible/characters/foreshadows/timeline/outline/status), Markdown manuscripts with per-revision snapshots, an append-only JSONL event log, and an editorial workspace (transaction receipts, per-revision fact snapshots, judge scores, decision log). Chapter submissions are transactional: pending/done receipts bound to a content hash, optimistic concurrency via expected_rev, and an idempotent retry path. Writes to one book are serialized in-process and across processes by a lock file. Also ships an MCP server exposing the same tools to any MCP client (workspace root enforced at boot), a two-role editorial preset for DSH, and a WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy) expert package built from the same host-agnostic capability table (editor-in-chief as lead, author as teammate, tool-face isolation rendered per host into the host's own carrier directory). No runtime dependencies. The code does the bookkeeping; the model does the writing.
